item.text: [{"task_id":"1a244afd","source_lines":["def match(points, anchors, index, used, zero):","    if index == len(points):","        return (zero, [])","    r, c = points[index]","    best = None","    for j in range(len(anchors)):","        if j in used:","            continue","        a, b = anchors[j]","        if r - a != zero and c - b != zero:","            continue","        tail = match(points, anchors, index + 1, used + [j], zero)","        if tail is None:","            continue","        cost = int(np.abs(r - a) + np.abs(c - b)) + tail[0]","        if best is None or cost < best[0]:","            best = (cost, [(index, j)] + tail[1])","    return best","def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    anchor = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    result_color = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    zero = int(round(params['alignment'][0]))","    rotation = [int(round(v)) for v in params['rotation']]","    points = np.argwhere(grid == marker).tolist()","    anchors = np.argwhere(grid == anchor).tolist()","    pairing = match(points, anchors, 0, [], zero)","    out = grid.copy()","    out[grid == marker] = background","    if pairing is None:","        return out","    for i, j in pairing[1]:","        r, c = points[i]","        a, b = anchors[j]","        dr = r - a","        dc = c - b","        nr = a + rotation[0] * dr + rotation[1] * dc","        nc = b + rotation[2] * dr + rotation[3] * dc","        if 0 <= nr < grid.shape[0] and 0 <= nc < grid.shape[1]:","            out[nr, nc] = result_color","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"alignment":[1],"rotation":[4]},"params":{"colors":[8,1,6,7],"alignment":[0],"rotation":[0,-1,1,0]},"rationale":"Pair each magenta marker with a distinct blue anchor sharing its row or column, minimizing total distance. Rotate each marker's displacement 90 degrees counterclockwise around its anchor, recolor it orange, and discard positions outside the grid."}]
